title: The Courses page
question: The roll dealt the Two-Pane Index. Lock it, or take the Practice Log or the Save Slots.

options.label: The Two-Pane Index
options.lineage: the mail client: a ruled index on the left, the open thing on the right
options.thesis: The library and the live Course sit side by side — the index to find and switch, the open pane to resume, with where you are and what comes next already in front of you.
options.viewport: Left, a search field over a ruled index grouped into Needs you / In progress / Done, each row carrying Topic, last touched and the done fraction; right, the selected Course's own page — its module and Lesson position, the next Lesson title, Continue, and its state. On a phone the live Course leads and the index follows.
options.risk: A split gives one Course a lot of room for one fact; when nothing is live the right pane has to earn its place or the page reads as an empty mailbox.

regions.label: index · needs you / in progress / done, last touched
open Course · where you are, next Lesson, continue

options.label: The Practice Log
options.lineage: the dated practice journal a musician or a runner keeps
options.thesis: The library reads as a dated log — the top of the page is always where you left off, the work waiting on you heads it, and everything else is grouped by when you last touched it.
options.viewport: A band of what is waiting on you, then mono date headings — Today, This week, Earlier — over ruled entries carrying Topic, where you are, its state word and the last-touched date. Search sits at the foot with the archive's tail.
options.risk: A log is honest about recency and blind to everything else; a Course you have not opened for a month sinks to the bottom, where a library-scale page still has to find it.

regions.label: dated entries · Course, where you are, state, last touched

options.label: The Save Slots
options.lineage: a game's continue screen: slots with where you are, progress and last played
options.thesis: The page is a continue screen — the last-played Course gets the one unmistakable Continue, and every other Course is a slot carrying where you are, how far in, and when you last played.
options.viewport: The live Course as a single wide continue block: Topic, module and Lesson position, the next Lesson, and Continue; below it a ruled table of slots — Course, where you are, progress, last played — with a Course that needs a decision flagged in its state column.
options.risk: The games register can read playful for a calm desk, and slots imply a small fixed count while the library runs past thirty.

regions.label: continue · the last-played Course, next Lesson
